scope: Bounded independent cold review of the published result-store candidate and diagnostic/regression source; no global campaign review.
findings: Scalar and batch latest-result digests are retained only at the original guarded comparison point. Complete observations remain private structured clones; external case/source callbacks receive separate clones.
Scalar publication returns the stored graph already cloned with the complete final envelope. Regressions retain callback/caller isolation and final-envelope getter and clone-failure observability.

The new final batch case-digest WeakMap is lazy, per-invocation and created only after the independent final envelope clone and sameRequest. Object identity preserves separate latest/final observations. All per-occurrence guards, callbacks and output clones remain.

The same-version objective-drift regression uses real CAS after the fourth source callback and requires both duplicate occurrences to be denied after three fresh C08 reads. It distinguishes full content comparison from version-only validation.

Source union keeps complete canonical reference equality and first-occurrence order. Separate calculation-path work counters and replay/refusal controls qualify it; it is not treated as evidence of P03-path improvement.

The diagnostic preserves C08 reader/work identity, both persistence callback arguments, receivers, original primitive implementations and returned promises. Numeric-only spy history accounting and entry/phase/report clears replace B0's unbounded framework recording.
The diagnostic includes an unsupported-canonical-value preflight to check exception preservation through active-call spy clearing. Runtime confirmation remains required.
C08 opaque reads and criterion-comparison's independent observations and replay remain unchanged. No rejected58 projection or foreign product/workflow modification is present.

materiality_judgment.criterion: A measured structural reduction of redundant full-graph producer traversals, with equivalent outputs, callbacks and negative controls, is sufficient to qualify one original P03 under the mission's stated rule; no new elapsed-time or percentage threshold is invented.
materiality_judgment.limits: This is bounded producer-work materiality, not evidence that the dominant composed P03 cost is fixed. Preserve the larger unresolved C08 and Planner-verifier callsites in the handoff.
materiality_judgment.B0: Unbounded spy history contaminates B0 timing and memory comparisons. Use only revised identical B2/R1 observer/test bytes for qualification; do not claim a product heap bound.

remaining_requirements: R1 must confirm exact removed work, stable functional output digests and unchanged callback/fence behavior against B2, with observer availability, exception preservation, pending=0 and cleared-history residuals.
A45 must qualify the exact V1 composition, including readonly59's contract dependency.
Only after material candidate/regressions qualify may one original P03 run with all 72 assertions and 180000 ms unchanged. Its result and any failure remain independent evidence.
